bullets.text: Windows ML Now Available - **Windows ML** empowers developers to deploy local AI efficiently across diverse Windows devices.
30% Reduction in Data Breaches - **Microsoft Purview** helps organizations achieve significant data breach prevention and compliance.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - New builds enhance user experience with fixes and features for **Windows 11** Insiders.
Gaming Copilot Beta Launch - **Gaming Copilot** provides AI-driven insights and recommendations for PC and Xbox players.
Microsoft's Leadership in IIoT - Recognized as a Leader in the **2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant** for Global Industrial IoT Platforms.
AI Datacenter Expansion - **Microsoft** unveils new AI datacenters to support advanced AI workloads and cloud services.
Microsoft Defender ROI - Organizations see a **242% ROI** with **Microsoft Defender**, enhancing security operations and reducing costs.
Blueprint for Secure AI Agents - **Azure AI Foundry** outlines a framework for building safe and secure AI agents.
Updates to Paint and Snipping Tool - Enhancements to **Paint** and **Snipping Tool** improve user creativity and efficiency.
Windows 365 Enhancements - **Windows 365** expands AI-driven cloud productivity solutions for diverse user needs.
